crossRefs.note: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

translations.web: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
translations.bsb: And when the messengers entered, there was the idol in the bed with the goat hair on its head.
translations.kjv: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.
translations.asv: And when the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats' hair at the head thereof.
